notes.title: The long-awaited OCR feature
notes.content:
This update content:
1. Added a shortcut key to activate the program, which can activate the program at the task location and focus on the search.
2. Fully open the OCR function, and you can directly OCR when you shift + right-click to copy anywhere.
3. Interface optimization, the main interface only displays the interface that needs to be displayed, and all others are moved to the settings.
4. Fixed the problem that text is occasionally recognized as a file.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41945026/baeb61c271c0ff90bb896a3c43e9455f870a5e06.png[/img]

notes.title: The Windows version has been significantly updated! V3.0
notes.content:
1. The interface is fully tool-based, which facilitates quick pasting in any window.
2. Remove all unnecessary elements and focus on the pasted content itself.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41945026/54915bee9286a8e5f249c1eec54ba32bb1d271d4.png[/img]

notes.title: Instant preview function adjustment
notes.content:
1. Add the pin text function. Right-click the clipboard text option and select pin to display it in the top-level form.
2. The real-time preview function has been adjusted. You can hold down Shift when copying text or pictures on any interface, and the copied content will be displayed directly in the top-level form. [This function can well solve the problem that software such as WeChat cannot open multiple pictures for viewing at the same time]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41945026/4a6bee7ee70d2b0bb5b85ad2b10592072f8fa4b0.jpg[/img]
